name: Delicate Arch
description: Delicate Arch, a 2-hour desert day hike at Arches National Park. The exposed slickrock offers no shade. Pack enough water and get moving.

name: Grandview Point
description: Grandview Point, a breezy desert walk above the canyon at Canyonlands. The mesa is wide open and exposed. Keep your energy up. Pack food and water.
